choice: Check only the status and the {error, code} shape for 404/405/413, and test the limit with a 9.5 kB body (accepted) and a 20 kB body (rejected), both with Content-Length and chunked
text: How strictly should the acceptance tests pin the 404 / 405 / 413 error codes and the exact 10 kB byte limit?
why: The spec doesn't name those codes or say whether 10 kB means 10,000 or 10,240 bytes, so the builder picks; the chunked case makes sure the limit isn't enforced only from the Content-Length header.
